details:
Currently, the "Preferred Language" change button is located in a hard-to-reach, deeply nested area, causing two inconveniences for non-native English speakers.

Since the core issue is that this setting is buried too deep within the menu structure, I propose adding a button or icon to the Quick Menu while retaining the existing button.

1. It is difficult for users wishing to change their "Preferred Language" to either resolve the issue independently or receive guidance.

For instance, suppose a user currently has their "Preferred Language" set to English and wants to switch to Japanese.

To reach the correct setting, they must decipher multiple setting labels displayed in English and navigate through the UI correctly.

To get a sense of the difficulty involved for certain users, try this scenario: 

switch the language to a completely unfamiliar language (Language A), 

close the menu, 

reopen it, 

and then attempt to revert it to a language you can easily read (Language B).

It's easy, or not?

I have encountered countless Japanese players who continue to play with the language set to English simply because of this. However, from an internationalization perspective, I believe this is an issue that extends beyond just the EN-JP language pair.

2. Inconvenience when conveying specific setting names to speakers of other languages

The current "Preferred Language" feature works effectively, and I deeply appreciate the efforts made to maintain high-quality localization.

However, situations often arise—particularly during conversations between language learners or within some game worlds—where I want to explain the name of a UI label or a setting in the other person's language.

If I switch the UI to the language I am currently learning (English, in my case) to facilitate this, I face a conflicting issue: when I want to convey a setting name to a native speaker of my own language, I cannot recall what it is called in that language.

Consequently, I personally find myself wanting to switch back and forth between Japanese and English.

Yes, for most players, this might be this language setting they change just once and then forget about. It would certainly be easy to simply attribute the issue primarily to a lack of language proficiency.

However, I believe there is room for engineering solutions to help alleviate the problem.

Given that various settings are added or modified with every update, it is safer to verify them directly via the UI rather than relying on memorizing documentation.

Of course, making it easier to access the "Preferred Language" setting via the Quick Menu would be counterproductive if it led to the situation described in point 1.

While UI design considerations to minimize human error are necessary, I think the current implementation already makes it easy enough to choose between "apply changes" and "close without saving."

Furthermore, I feel that casually proposing solutions that inadvertently disadvantage minority languages ​​smacks of intolerance—something I wish to avoid at all costs.
title: "Preferred Language" setting should be changeable from Quick Menu
